reviews.review:
Definitely a great game and well worth my money spent. A controller's definitely recommended, but I've seen my brother play the game well with only a keyboard. I liked the learning curve I spent on the game, and I also enjoyed seeing my mastery over some characters improve. However, some relics can make the game a little too easy and less risky overall. It really is your choice overall on whether you want to have the relics on or off. I feel like the game can balance the relics out a bit, especially the Command relic. Maybe enemies can explode, but the explosions can hurt enemies too (not for a lot), or maybe you can choose your item, but you won't be able to choose the ones you haven't unlocked in addition to probably a time limit you can spend before some indestructible entity comes and tries to kill you.

Either way, loved the game. Multiplayer requires port forwarding though.
You start having fun, then every enemy becomes a bullet sponge and killing anything becomes a tedious game of run and gun.
Fun game, great to play and hold me off while I wait for No Man's Sky.

Do you enjoy being terrible at a difficult game that passive-agressively mocks you whenever you die?
Do you want to find unique items that either do nothing or make you basically ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ invincible?
Do you like excellent music?
Do you absolutely dispise rain?

If you answered yes to any of these questions, this is the game for you!







Also if you answered no to any of these questions you need to buy it.
Just buy it.

These comments are more for the devs than anyone looking to buy the game.

I love RoR, I just wish there was more items/monsters/levels, and I would happily pay for an expansion pack or DLC that added a bit more.

I figured with Deadbolt being your primary focus now, we may not see much in the way of updates for a while, but people would go wild for more content.  Just look at Isaac's expansions and updates that kept the game alive.

Much love, thanks for the hours of fun <3.
